verdict.rationale: An HR and payroll platform could plausibly offer workflow automations with version history and rollback, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back user automations. The header-based API date versioning (deel-docs-31) governs API changes, not user automations. The sandbox reset (deel-docs-5) restores test data, not automation versions. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.
